blocks.text: The administrative tax on technical recruiters

Your day is likely fragmented. You juggle high volume communication with complex data management. You might feel like you spend more time in your applicant tracking system than talking to candidates. This is a common struggle. Studies suggest recruiters spend between 60 and 80 percent of their week on administrative tasks. You are not alone if your calendar feels like a battlefield.
How to manage your candidate tracking system help

When you need candidate tracking system help, you do not need more complexity. You need a way to move faster. Lazur lives in your Mac notch. It sees your screen and listens to your voice. You hold ⌥ ⌘ to ask about your current screen. If you are stuck in an ATS like Workable or SmartRecruiters, ask Lazur where a specific field is. Lazur draws a circle around it.

Interview scheduling is the largest drain on your time. You send emails, check calendars, and deal with reschedules. Lazur can draft your follow up emails in Gmail. Hold fn and dictate your message. Lazur formats the text for you. You can also ask Lazur to check your calendar for free slots before you reply. This saves you from switching between browser tabs constantly.
Use the fn key to dictate your candidate feedback directly into Notion or your ATS. This keeps your hands on the keyboard and your focus on the resume.

blocks.text: Sourcing and screening with more focus

You spend an average of 7.4 seconds on an initial resume scan. You need to be fast. Use Lazur to research a company or a candidate profile while you stay in your browser. Lazur uses its own Chrome tabs to find info. It brings back a summary. You do not have to leave your current workflow to get the context you need.
Your Mac setup for high volume recruiting

Most recruiters on Mac use a browser heavy setup. You might have LinkedIn Recruiter Lite, hireEZ, and your ATS open at once. Use a tool like SupaSidebar to manage your tabs. When you feel lost, ask Lazur to guide you through a task. For example, ask how to create a new pipeline stage in your ATS. Lazur waits for you to click each step. It is like having a colleague look over your shoulder.

blocks.text: You handle sensitive candidate data. Lazur respects this. It only sees your screen and listens to your audio when you hold the shortcut keys. No data is stored on external servers. Your conversations and screenshots are not used to train AI models. Always follow your employer rules regarding candidate data and privacy when using any tool.

faq.question: Can Lazur click buttons in my ATS for me?
faq.answer: No. Lazur does not click buttons or operate apps for you. It points at buttons to show you where they are or guides you through a process step by step.

faq.question: Does Lazur work with my specific ATS?
faq.answer: Lazur works on your Mac screen. It does not need a direct integration with your ATS. If you can see the ATS in your browser, Lazur can help you navigate it.

faq.question: How much time can I save using voice for admin tasks?
faq.answer: While results vary, reducing manual data entry and scheduling time can significantly lower your administrative load. Recruiters spend up to 80 percent of their time on these tasks, so even small improvements add up.
